node.title: XR profile minor record-inventory soundness
node.statement: If an inventory covers every budget-meeting unpaid non-boundary light-triangle profile and assigns each profile an admissible record of an accepted nonzero-minor type, then xr_profile_minor_certificate_payload holds.
node.attack_surface: formal coverage and accepted-record dispatch for XR minor certificate inventories
node.falsifier: a complete inventory of accepted nonzero-minor records while some required XR profile lacks a valid payload record
